As the weather turns cooler and the autumn outdoor activity season begins, I usually adjust my everyday carry list to suit my lifestyle habits. If you're looking for something tougher and more durable, suitable for hiking and water activities yet still usable as a daily wallet, the Pelican MagSafe wallet and card holder is my top pick.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you the latest news about MagSafe and the wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless-charging-supported Apple devices.

Best for outdoor activities

The Pelican wallet has an IPX4 water-resistance rating, meaning if it gets wet while hiking or at the lake, your credit cards and cash won't be soaked. Once latched shut, it stays sealed — for example, in autumn I go to quite a few Falcons games, and even when watching American football, I like knowing everything is securely stowed away. That alone makes it a practical choice for autumn outdoor activities, as the weather can change quickly. It doesn't feel like a wallet; it feels more like a small hard-shell protective case that snaps onto your iPhone.

Most MagSafe wallets are designed to hold a few cards with no other functionality. Pelican's design gives you more flexibility — you can easily fit your ID and credit cards, with room for a few folded bills and a small key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet already covers the basics, so you don't need to bring a separate bag.

Although the Pelican wallet is mainly aimed at outdoor use, it also works well as an everyday carry item. It uses strong magnets to attach firmly to the back of your iPhone, and with its latched design, nothing falls out. Compared with other less durable MagSafe wallets, this one sacrifices a bit of slimness in exchange for more reliable protection. If you want a minimal, lightweight wallet for summer, I might not pick it, but for hiking, watching American football, or any outdoor activity where the weather might change, it's a perfect fit. For kids who just got their first iPhone, this is also a great MagSafe wallet option. My older son has been using his for several years now.

Pelican MagSafe wallet summary

The Pelican MagSafe wallet is built for people who value durability, protecting your essentials from weather and water, enough for a multi-stop trip or a day out, and it stays securely attached. If you want a MagSafe wallet that can handle a drop and works well day to day, this is the one for you.

You can buy this Pelican MagSafe wallet on Amazon or directly from the Pelican website.
